title: Frappe ERPNext 6.3.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 6.3.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, to retrieve party address details such as city, state, postal code, and country by sending crafted requests with arbitrary customer, supplier, or address names. The vulnerability does not require elevated privileges but does require authentication.
